title: The wingman
premise: Marcus thinks it is a date. Jess wants him as her wingman for the guy who owns a company. Six months later Marcus owns one, and on the same terrace he asks her to be his wingwoman.

shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a sunny cafe terrace with small round tables, a striped awning and potted olive trees, bright flat midday light, {jess}, in a yellow sundress with a thin white cardigan, gripping the grey hoodie sleeve of someone just off camera with one hand and pointing past the camera with the other, biting her lip, eyes wide and sparkling at whoever she is pointing at, mouth open mid-whisper. Vertical composition, no text anywhere in the image.
shots.motion_prompt: Jess tugs the sleeve twice and points, her mouth moving as she whispers it fast and excited, bouncing on her toes. Quick push-in on her sparkling eyes.
shots.speaker: jess

shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a sunny cafe terrace with small round tables, a striped awning and potted olive trees, bright flat midday light, {marcus}, in a wrinkled grey hoodie over a white tee, holding a small bunch of yellow tulips up in front of his chest with both hands, his hopeful smile collapsing, eyebrows pinched up in the middle, eyes flicking from the flowers to someone off camera, mouth open mid-sentence. Vertical composition, no text anywhere in the image.
shots.motion_prompt: Marcus looks down at the tulips in his hands and back up, his mouth moving as he says it in a small confused voice, the smile sliding off his face. Slow push-in.
shots.vo_line: I thought this was a date.
shots.speaker: marcus
